question: Does a revision of the contingent two-step policy, chosen from the stopping-gap diagnosis, improve real mechanism decisions without unacceptable wrong-elimination risk?

seen_before_freeze.sciplex3: everything: blocks 2 and 3, the follow-up's recorded sequences, the Phase 1 attribution and the Phase 2 matched replay
seen_before_freeze.l1000: metadata only: condition counts, vehicle-null thresholds, detection counts per line and time, class pools and sizes, batch shares and the cache-versus-official signature-strength concordance
seen_before_freeze.l1000_not_seen: no validator calibration, leave-one-out outcome, held-out reading, forecast or policy decision

intervention.name: two_step_fallback
intervention.base: the follow-up's contingent two-step planner (plan_two_step), unchanged
intervention.rule: When the base planner would defer before the first measurement, or stop after a neutral or QC-failed result, classify why. If the cause is uninformed (no_references, no_paired_references, or inadequate_support_or_uncertainty: positive on raw reference frequencies, not after the planner's Jeffreys shrinkage), take the fixed early-to-late sequence's next legal action. If the references it has forecast no correct elimination or a wrong-elimination risk above the 2:1 break-even, stop as before, with the named reason.
never: forecasts or simulated branches update EvidenceState
an unsupported branch is given a probability
intervention.justification: Phase 1: 89 of 106 tier-A stops after a neutral first reading (610 of 767 in tier B) were uninformed; stops and deferrals, not measurement choice, carried about 85% of the fixed sequence's tier-A advantage.

rules_shared_by_every_arm.order: distinct actions; exposure time never earlier than any executed action, failed assays included
rules_shared_by_every_arm.qc: primary 'continue': a failed assay is charged, updates nothing, every arm chooses again; sensitivity 'stop' (SciPlex3 only; L1000 episode compounds are measured at every menu condition, so no QC failure can occur there)
rules_shared_by_every_arm.stops: after any elimination, after two measurements, when no legal action remains, or when the arm names a stop
rules_shared_by_every_arm.evidence: common.evidence_update on real executed results only (registered OutcomeRules)

sciplex3_exploratory.status: diagnosis-informed; reported, never used for the verdict

l1000.data: GSE92742 local metadata and the derived subset48 condition cache, prepared by lincs_prepare.py (hashes in freeze.json)
l1000.profile: cache condition mean over 978 measured landmark genes
l1000.qc: >=2 wells on >=2 plates, finite values, and a matched official signature (same compound, line, time, 10 uM, batch) with >=2 replicates
l1000.detection: median distil_cc_q75 of matched signatures >= max(0.10, 0.99 quantile of DMSO ctl_vehicle signatures with >=2 replicates at the same line and time)
l1000.labels: exact Repurposing Hub join by Broad compound ID, else full InChIKey; single-mechanism records only
l1000.pool: per tier, classes with >=6 InChIKey identity groups among compounds measured at every tier condition, of which >=2 are detected at some tier condition
l1000.folds: 5; connected components of shared InChIKey connectivity block or Bemis-Murcko scaffold, round-robin in SHA256 order within class strata

LT.menu: A549, MCF7, PC3, VCAP x 6 h, 24 h at 10 uM

T.menu: A549 x 6 h, 24 h at 10 uM

l1000.episodes: every eligible held-out compound against every other pool class; hypothesis order by the SciPlex3 seeded coin (episodes.episode_list)
l1000.validator: the SciPlex3 validator unchanged (shared-axis projected cosine, detected templates, floor and margin) with its calibration grid and 5% maximum wrong-elimination rate, per fold on training compounds only
l1000.gate: a tier is evaluated only if its calibrated validator can eliminate in >=3 of 5 folds; a failed gate gives no verdict from that tier

secondary: contrasts against da, da_unconditioned, production, one_step_utility
step-1 forecast calibration: ECE and Brier of the truth-branch correct-elimination probability, all menu actions, 10 equal-width bins
support-stratified rates: contrast support = the smaller number of training compounds of the two hypotheses at the fixed first condition, strata <=3, 4-7, >=8
plate diagnostic: share of eliminating readings whose nearest winning-class template shares the held-out batch, against the class's template batch share

inference.unit_l1000: the held-out compound's fold component (shared identity block or scaffold)
sensitivity: L1000: identity group; batch cohort (batch of the A549 6 h measurement) with leave-one-batch-out range
SciPlex3: compound; Bemis-Murcko scaffold; plate cohort with leave-one-cohort-out range

decision.applies_to: L1000 tier LT; tier T only as the consistency condition of PROMOTE
order: INCONCLUSIVE if the LT gate fails
REJECT if the fallback-minus-two_step utility interval lies wholly below 0, or its wrong-elimination interval lies wholly above +0.02

PROMOTE if fallback-minus-two_step utility lower bound > 0 and wrong upper bound <= 0.02, and fallback-minus-fixed utility lower bound > 0 and wrong upper bound <= 0.02, and in tier T both utility point estimates are >= 0
SHADOW if fallback-minus-two_step utility lower bound > 0 and wrong upper bound <= 0.02

meaning.PROMOTE: eligible for an implementation review as the default two-measurement sequencing rule; nothing is switched automatically
meaning.SHADOW: keep opt-in and logged; better than the policy it revises, not better than the fixed sequence
